title: Bounded LLM patch with hashed prompt provenance
provenance_note: Reference pattern for a bounded LLM patch path. The model label and prompt_sha256 model how a real agent patch would attach provenance. The raw prompt is never stored or exported; only its SHA-256 hash. This fixture remains deterministic and does not make a live LLM call.

simulated_agent.name: demo-bounded-llm-worker
simulated_agent.input_signal: redacted: one-line code task; raw prompt withheld, hash retained

patch.diff:
diff --git a/tasks/priority_test.py b/tasks/priority_test.py
--- a/tasks/priority_test.py
+++ b/tasks/priority_test.py
@@ -7,6 +7,10 @@
 
 def test_describe_task_keeps_leaf_label_readable():
     assert describe_task("NLFR-3", 72) == "NLFR-3: normal"
+
+
+def test_priority_band_marks_backlog_for_low_score():
+    assert priority_band(10) == "backlog"
 
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":

expected_result.why: The bounded LLM patch adds a single leaf assertion exercising existing library behavior.

proof_claims.statement: The bounded LLM patch carries a model label and a SHA-256 prompt hash; the raw prompt is not stored.
The candidate patch touched only a leaf test file in the demo workload.
A real recorder run may claim the target passed only after Bazel test evidence is captured and ingested.
